description: This file defines a SubmissionService class responsible for managing data product submissions, including creating, ensuring minimal test submissions, retrieving, and updating submissions along with associated audit logging. It interacts with a database connection, other services, and handles submission lifecycle and workflow states.

classes.name: SubmissionService
classes.description: Service for submission lifecycle and state management, including creating submissions, ensuring test submissions, retrieving, and updating submission states, with audit logging.

methods.name: None ensure_minimal_submission_for_tests(self, submission_id: str)
methods.description: Ensures a minimal, valid submission exists for specific test IDs, creating draft and submission entries if necessary.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_submission( self, draft_id: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Creates a new submission from a draft, enqueues validation job, and records audit events.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_submission(self, submission_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a submission by its ID.

methods.description: Updates the state of a submission and records the change via audit logs.
